parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。可以通过调用ListApplication接口获取，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the elastic compute container (ECC) that corresponds to the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance on which you want to stop the application. You can call the QueryApplicationStatus operation to query the ECC ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html.

If you want to stop the application on multiple ECS instances, separate the ECC IDs with commas (,).

If you leave this parameter empty, the application will be stopped on all ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
应用下需要停止的ECS实例的EccId。可以通过调用QueryApplicationStatus接口获取EccId，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html。

如果包含多个ECS实例，用半角逗号（,）分开。
不设置该参数，表示停止该应用下所有实例
parameters.name: ecc_info
